editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Forex4you scores 4.4/10 from NAFT in 2026. A BVI-regulated offshore broker operating since 2007 with Share4you copy trading, MT4/MT5 platforms, spreads from 0.0 pips on Pro accounts ($6 RT), and leverage up to 1:1000. The problem — no Tier-1 licence after 17 years, no investor compensation scheme, no guaranteed fund segregation under BVI law, and genuinely mixed user reviews across public platforms. Legit in the sense that it has operated continuously without regulatory shutdowns, but the offshore-only structure means you carry all the risk if anything goes wrong.
